description: Implementation of file handling functions for Windows platform in the Chromium project, including file operations such as read, write, seek, get info, lock, unlock, and duplicate.

classes.name: File
classes.description: A class providing file operations on Windows, including read, write, seek, get info, lock, unlock, duplicate, and set length.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the file handle is valid.

methods.name: GetPlatformFile
methods.description: Returns the underlying platform file handle.

methods.name: TakePlatformFile
methods.description: Transfers ownership of the platform file handle.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the file handle.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Moves the file pointer to a specified offset based on whence.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from a specified offset.

methods.name: ReadAtCurrentPos
methods.description: Reads data at the current file position.

methods.name: ReadNoBestEffort
methods.description: Reads data from a specified offset, with no special tracing.

methods.name: ReadAtCurrentPosNoBestEffort
methods.description: Reads data at the current position, with no special tracing.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data at a specified offset.

methods.name: WriteAtCurrentPos
methods.description: Writes data at the current position.

methods.name: WriteAtCurrentPosNoBestEffort
methods.description: Writes data at the current position, with no special tracing.

methods.name: GetLength
methods.description: Returns the size of the file.

methods.name: SetLength
methods.description: Sets the length of the file.

methods.name: GetInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about the file.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks the file.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the file.

methods.name: Duplicate
methods.description: Creates a duplicate handle of the file.

methods.name: OSErrorToFileError
methods.description: Converts Windows error codes to internal file error codes.

methods.name: DoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the file handle with given path and flags.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the file buffers.

methods.name: SetPlatformFile
methods.description: Sets the platform file handle.

methods.name: GetLastFileError
methods.description: Retrieves the last file error.
